title: PMCR-O Trail Frame (Class B, one JSONL line)
$comment: Trail-as-Product: every line appended to orchestrate.jsonl / plan.jsonl / make.jsonl / check.jsonl / reflect.jsonl is an instance of this schema, not hand-typed prose. Each phase file is owned by exactly one role, which is the only role that appends to it: orchestrate.jsonl <- orchestrator, plan.jsonl <- planner, make.jsonl <- maker, check.jsonl <- checker, reflect.jsonl <- reflector. No absolute, host-specific, or drive-letter paths in any field — reference files repo-relative (e.g. 'plugins/pmcro-trail/...'), never 'P:\\...'.

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp this frame was emitted.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number within this phase file, starting at 1.

content.description: Free-form payload, e.g. verbatim MessySeedIntent text.

step_index.description: MakeStep only — which PlanFrame step.index this executes.

action.description: MakeStep only — what was actually done.
